analysis.translation_en: He was a boy, she was a girl, can I make it any more obvious? He was a punk, she did ballet, what more can I say? He wanted her, and she would never tell, but secretly she wanted him as well. But all of her friends stuck up their nose; they had a problem with his baggy clothes. He was a skater boy, she said see you later boy, he was not good enough for her. She had a pretty face, but her head was up in space, she needed to come back down to earth. Five years from now, she sits at home, feeding the baby, she is all alone. She turns on TV, guess who she sees? Skater boy rocking up MTV. She calls up her friends, they already know, and they have all got tickets to see his show. She tags along, stands in the crowd, looks up at the man that she turned down. He was a skater boy, she said see you later boy, he was not good enough for her. Now he is a superstar, slamming on his guitar, does your pretty face see what he is worth? We are in love, have not you heard how we rock each other's world? I am with the skater boy, I said see you later boy, I will be backstage after the show, I will be at the studio singing the song we wrote about a girl you used to know.

Thinking "God, how complicated this love thing is"
She asked herself what detail it could have been
That Cupid surely misunderstood

He was tossing and turning in bed like every night
Suddenly a romantic song played on the radio

And others prefer to call coincidence

And they dance

Round the earth forgotten by the sun, shadows brood.

Saint Lucy, Saint Lucy.

Behold, upon our threshold stands, dressed in white with light in her hair, Saint Lucy, Saint Lucy.
Darkness shall soon flee from the earth's valleys.
Thus she speaks a wondrous word to us.
Day shall rise again anew out of the rosy sky,
Saint Lucy, Saint Lucy.

analysis.translation_en:
Almost five in the morning, sleep will not come to me
Outside in chalky whiteness, snow is slowly falling
Leaving, you said the weather was so bad
And I know I will not fall asleep again tonight.

Outside the window, there in the dark, time crawls like a snail
Across in the park, three stray dogs run
Only comforted by the thought that despair exists—
So many are not sleeping tonight, I am not alone.

So many stars shine in the sky
But I would trade them
For that dream that would be so real
And that allows one to sleep until morning, sleep until morning

How diverse people are and how different their thoughts
One has birds in their head, another shoes and bags
Someone counts victories, but someone only scars
I count sleepless nights

How I wish I could fall asleep and sleep until morning
While outside snow falls in chalky whiteness
And comforted by the thought that morning is already close
And that so many are not sleeping, as proven

So many stars shine in the sky,
But I would trade them
For that dream that would be so real
And that allows one to sleep until morning

So many stars shine in the sky,
But I am still searching for the right one
The bright moon that seemed so steadfast
Suddenly falls and turns out to be fragile

And then the sun rises over the city
A new day blooms in white snow clocks.

Giving your first love to a partner only brought back heaviness

Climbing the ladder of growing up, one only learns to bow to society's rules

Constantly agonizing over what life is

Lost your sense of direction for the sake of making a living

analysis.translation_en:
Bro, it's been a month since I wrote a rhyme
It had never happened to me before
I put another bud inside the rolling paper
And I fistfight with my self-esteem
It's life that brings me here where there's nothing left to say
Where it's impossible to find the source and climb back up
And find me someone working in a call-center who can tell me
That they're not ready to be left with nothing just to get away
And leave all the darkness here behind, to fly away with the truth
That you carry on your back, even when you know well you shouldn't
I've got shit following me everywhere, but I'm not looking for compensation anymore
I want to make rhymes until no one knows my identity anymore
Because you believe a voice more than a face
It's a cross, I've said it in more than one track
But I know that if a song is made from the heart
It turns every terrible day into a smile
So fuck it, even if you try, I won't give up
Hang up the mic on the wall, bro, I won't do it
And any advice from you, bro, I don't take it in
You don't close your rhymes, bro, I'm opening them up
So you can step inside and stop talking bullshit
Like there is no feeling
When I cry overwhelmed by resentment
While you write made-up fun storytelling
My head is exploding and veins throb at my temples
I empty the glass but my pride doesn't fill up
And I find myself sweating in the usual room
I fight, but her absence is felt
And I need to smoke and be with my brothers
Otherwise I break down and pull my hair out
And I push the keys, red ones too
Because blood is coming out of my fingertips
This life here is shit, and to make it less bitter
I drive around with 4 lit joints with Secco inside a Grand Vitara
And there's little you can do if a cop shoots me
Anyway, around here the State gives you bullets for free
I smoke a flare and think about every asshole competing
Who has their life all mapped out
I have a thousand hallucinations but not one is clear
It's 3 nights in a row that I've been dreaming of a coffin
I wake up at night with whiplash
I hear at the door like a dead person knocking
That's why my situation is widely discussed
And that's why you then find me lying dead at Trilussa
My head dives into the most obscene problems
Only to put the headphones back on
What I advise you, bro, is to run away
Yeah, run away...

[Chorus]
Constantly and painfully contemplating what life is,
Only fearing that once you realize it, half your life has already passed.
The most romantic you, who once learned from butterflies to soar high in paradise, has lost your sense of direction to making a living.
Indulging in social clinking of glasses just to survive,
Overusing smiles in exchange for connections to endure in this city.
Since childhood hearing that the Three Little Pigs could find happiness, yet today's story is grim;
Perhaps the wolf coming is even more alluring.

[Chorus]
Where does the courage come from to contemplate this life?
How many ambitions embraced, how many bring contentment?
In the arena, negative energy has swallowed the smile across your face; is changing for fleeting glory meant to be eternal?
Do you still remember your innocence, your free self?
Taking sci-fi adventures like the Anywhere Door as real,
Since childhood, this little pig chased kites aimlessly with pure excitement;
When were your dreams sealed away?
Is it because when you were three years old in bed, the stories your mother told were so captivating—always fictionalized to be moving?

crime.text: The entire track is an indictment of systemic corruption, political assassinations, misuse of public funds, and judicial impunity.
crime.label: critique

violence.text: Mentions of firing into crowds at night, turning the city into a killing field, and pointing gun barrels at citizens.
violence.label: critique

weapons.text: References to rifles, gun barrels, bullets, and machine guns used by the military to dominate politics.
weapons.label: critique

coercion.text: Citizens forced to remain silent under threat of imprisonment or execution, living under military junta rule.
coercion.label: critique

money.text: Discussions of bribery shielding criminals from justice, hoarding embezzled cash, and counting money.
money.label: critique

materialism.text: Greed among leadership who squander the state budget and drive the system using money as magic.
materialism.label: critique

antisocial_narrative.text: Explicit call to defy state authority, raise the middle finger to the regime, and protest military oppression.
antisocial_narrative.label: endorsement

original_lyrics:

Le crépitement des flashs, la foule qui ressent l'effort

Des milliers d'têtes, des salles complètes de Marseille à Verdun

Quand je m'amuse, j'culpabilise
Un fou me gueule dans ma tête il m'dit qu'le disque ne se fera pas tout seul
Putain de système scolaire, j'gobe plus leurs histoires
Ils m'ont tellement traité de faible que j'ai failli y croire
Tu t'rends compte ? Moi, l'petit joufflu de l'école de la rue du Taur
J'devenais le plus jeune rappeur d'Europe à être disque d'or
Peur de devenir un connard, de faire partie de ces pitres
Tu sais ces stars qui se plaignent pour des photos et nous voient comme des chiffres
J'ai refusé des chèque parce que j'avais la flemme
Dans mes textes, je disais : "Aime ta mère" et j'faisais pleurer la mienne
Mais quel con j'étais quand j'y pense
J'pensais qu'à mes belles baskets, j'voulais faire partie de la deuxième France
Pas les sous pour une canette, j'en étais presque fou
Et je m'imaginais que les riches étaient bien plus heureux que nous
J'm'étais trompé, j'ai fait le tour de la France et de la question
J'ai vu des p'tits plein d'rêves et des gamines en manque d'affection
Faut que j'pète le score ouais faire de la thune c'est tentant

Je veux rire à m'en déchirer les abdos
Brûler nos complexes et nos vielles pulsions d'ados
J'te compte masquer nos peurs derrière des insultes sans mentir
Assumer ses pleurs, parait qu'c'est ça grandir

Imagine le silence et la honte devant tous mes potes
Imagine moi sans l'rap avec mon crâne, mes bras ballants
Imagine si j'vous avais pas, hein ? Si j'avais pas d'talent

La faucheuse m'a dit : "J'te laisse une chance si tu casses tout avec ton frère"
J'ai signé l'contrat, avant de partir en roue libre
Mais je stresse, je sais qu'elle m'attend en coulisse
Mon cher hip-hop, t'es décevant
Ils sortent un album tous les six mois, je sors un classique tous les deux ans
Et j'ai une équipe en or, hardcore
Si tu m'enlèves mon cœur, moi j'respire encore
J'évacue mes fractures et chacune de mes ratures
Mature faut que j'assure, quand mes lacunes saturent
J'vise la lune et j'évacue mes peurs
L'écriture de ma plume comme armure
J'rappe avec le cœur, j'fais pas ça pour m'acheter une voiture
J'ai croisé ceux dans la galère qui m'auraient tout donné
Dîné avec des millionnaires qui m'ont même pas payé l'café
Que mon frère et que la chance m'accompagne
J'vous ferai signe, si on arrive en haut de la montagne
De l'autre côté du miroir, j'voulais devenir quelqu'un
On a cru en notre histoire, on a forcé l'destin
J'ai failli m'perdre dans l'superficiel et l'paraître
Et j'ai pris l'temps d'écouter, d'regarder par la fenêtre
Cet album c'est pour le petit, qui s'ennuie en bas des tours
C'est pour ces vieux en manque d'amour, qui comptent les jours
Pour les passionnés, les p'tits rappeurs de ma ville
Pour mon meilleur pote qui a peur, qui sait pas quoi faire de sa vie
C'est pour les pas sur du tout, bouffés par le doute
Pour les timides, qui font demi-tour avant un rendez-vous
C'est pour les pas musclés, les complexés qui vivent quand même
Ceux qui ont jamais pris l'avion mais veulent la villa sur la mer
J'te promets pas les grands discours qu'on aime entendre
Moi j'ai pas d'mensonges ou de rêves à te vendre
Pas d'retouches, pas de paillettes pour être précis
Moi, j'te rappe juste, la vraie vie

Du hopper av hesten og gjær opp eit bål. 
Du har ingen evalueringstrang når sola går ned bak ein svart mustang. 

Og så kjem du fram til ein by i sør, 
der truleg Clint Eastwood har vore før, 
Der sjela blir kvesta og kroppen sett fri, 
men for deg gjer det lite at det er slik det blir. 

I ein draum… 

Og full det er du støtt, for moralen er 'kje født, 
så alt du tenkjer om alt det som blenkjer; det er slikt ein fær. 
Alt du treng er litt begjær og eit jentefang. 
Ein blank mustang tek deg snart ut på farten. 
Og hesten, ja, hesten heiter Svarten. 

Men vaknar, det gjer du. Og der ligg ho som spør: 
"Hott i kloden va'det du drøymde no?" 
Du svarar du har hatt deg ein opplevingstur bort ditt som cowboyar og indianarar bur. 

I ein draum…

Primo
Passo notti faccia a faccia con la notte in carne ed ossa fin da piccolo la supplico, le dico “damme tregua stronza”, Lei mi sfida come dire: “viemme sotto, forza!” rap sonnambulo, studio la contromossa. Siamo chi, che sia. Sopra un beat messia, siamo sgarri senza anestesia tra palco e narcolessia. Per non sentire il silenzio che strilla ho provato a cavalcare la mia baby camomilla. Sotto le lenzuola siamo una cosa sola se non fosse che sig. Paranoia mi divora -il corazón- che ore sò? Trardi! rime Vittorio Sgarbi voglio vedere all'obitorio tutti quanti. Che ne so di come posso sollevarti dal jet set e dal merdaio che hai davanti, rap replicanti. Dita sporche, pop corn, fighe morte, you porn tiro colpi dal bon, poi non voglio svegliarmi più.

Ensi
5 – ¼ dormi come un ghiro io non riesco neanche a chiudere gli occhi, mi guardo in giro ogni senso è amplificato, allucinato tipo – syrup – prendo gocce ma il mio letto è diventato quello di un fachiro. Pump up the – valium - imbottito tipo kamikaze non lo sento neanche, mi alzo e vago dentro queste stanze come in carcere cammino in cerchio, in un quadrato con le palpebre sbarrate, come il -blefarostato- non dormo mai come i soldi di Gordon Gekko, chiudo gli occhi e vedo i soldi del Jackpot. Per questo mi risveglio come da un coma profondo realizzo che non è passato molto tempo e il mondo è sempre uguale, stessa nave che sta affondando con il capitano che sta scappando. E noi siamo sempre qua con due grammi in tasca, e ce li fumiamo mentre già salutiamo l'alba.

Dig, du kan sgu gå fanden i vold!
